Definition: {to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)}
BiblicalUsage: The word is to put, to set, to make, and Daniel uses it for the king's decrees and the king's punishments. If ye will not make known the dream, your houses shall be made a dunghill; thou, O king, hast made a decree that every man shall fall down and worship; and a stone was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the putting shows the king's power and its limit: he sets decrees and stones, and God sets the end of both.
